USE synapseprojek;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.symmetric_keys
    WHERE name = N'##MS_DatabaseMasterKey##'
)
    CREATE MASTER KEY;
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.database_scoped_credentials
    WHERE name = N'syn_asprak_identity'
)
    CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL syn_asprak_identity
    WITH IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity';
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.external_data_sources
    WHERE name = N'ds_datacuaca_curated'
)
    CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE ds_datacuaca_curated
    WITH (
        LOCATION = 'https://adls1tcba.dfs.core.windows.net/curated',
        CREDENTIAL = syn_asprak_identity
    );
GO

SELECT TOP (10) *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'pertemuan8/C_delta_kota_bulan',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'ds_datacuaca_curated',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS r;
GO

-- 2. View polusi dan cuaca

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_polusi_cuaca AS
SELECT *
FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'pertemuan8/C_delta_kota_bulan',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'ds_datacuaca_curated',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
)
WITH (
    kota                 VARCHAR(20),
    tanggal              DATE,
    waktu                DATETIME2,
    jam                  INT,
    bulan                VARCHAR(7),
    pm10_ug_m3           FLOAT,
    pm2_5_ug_m3          FLOAT,
    no2_ug_m3            FLOAT,
    so2_ug_m3            FLOAT,
    o3_ug_m3             FLOAT,
    co_ug_m3             FLOAT,
    temperature_2m       FLOAT,
    relative_humidity_2m FLOAT,
    precipitation        FLOAT,
    wind_speed_10m       FLOAT,
    kategori_pm25        VARCHAR(30)
) AS r;
GO

SELECT name FROM sys.views;

SELECT TOP (10) * FROM dbo.vw_polusi_cuaca;
GO

-- 3. View koordinat kota

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.vw_kota AS
SELECT *
FROM (VALUES
    ('bandung',   'Bandung',   -6.9175, 107.6191),
    ('denpasar',  'Denpasar',  -8.6705, 115.2126),
    ('jakarta',   'Jakarta',   -6.2088, 106.8456),
    ('semarang',  'Semarang',  -6.9667, 110.4167),
    ('surabaya',  'Surabaya',  -7.2575, 112.7521),
    ('surakarta', 'Surakarta', -7.5755, 110.8243)
) AS k(kota, nama_kota, latitude, longitude);
GO

SELECT * FROM dbo.vw_kota;
GO

-- 2. Hitung rata-rata, maksimum, dan minimum AQI per kota, serta tambahkan
--    1 query agregrasi bebas sesuai kreatifitas kalian

DROP VIEW dbo.v_gabungan;

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW dbo.v_gabungan AS
SELECT 
    t.filepath(1) AS kota,
    CAST(t.waktu AS DATETIME2) AS waktu_dt,
    t.pm10_ug_m3, 
    t.pm2_5_ug_m3, 
    t.no2_ug_m3, 
    t.so2_ug_m3, 
    t.o3_ug_m3, 
    t.co_ug_m3
FROM 
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK '/raw/data/*/*/*.csv',
        DATA_SOURCE = 'data_cuaca',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        FIRSTROW = 2
    ) 
    WITH (
        waktu NVARCHAR(50),
        pm10_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        pm2_5_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        no2_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        so2_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        o3_ug_m3 FLOAT,
        co_ug_m3 FLOAT
    ) AS t;
GO

 -- rata-rata, maksimum, minimum per kota 
SELECT 
    kota,
    ROUND(AVG(pm2_5_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_pm2_5,
    MAX(pm2_5_ug_m3) AS max_pm2_5,
    MIN(pm2_5_ug_m3) AS min_pm2_5,
    ROUND(AVG(pm10_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_pm10,
    MAX(pm10_ug_m3) AS max_pm10,
    MIN(pm10_ug_m3) AS min_pm10,
    ROUND(AVG(no2_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_no2,
    MAX(no2_ug_m3) AS max_no2,
    MIN(no2_ug_m3) AS min_no2,
    ROUND(AVG(so2_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_so2,
    MAX(so2_ug_m3) AS max_so2,
    MIN(so2_ug_m3) AS min_so2,
    ROUND(AVG(o3_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_o3,
    MAX(o3_ug_m3) AS max_o3,
    MIN(o3_ug_m3) AS min_o3,
    ROUND(AVG(co_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_co,
    MAX(co_ug_m3) AS max_co,
    MIN(co_ug_m3) AS min_co
FROM dbo.v_gabungan
GROUP BY kota
ORDER BY kota;

-- peringkat kota dengan total populasi (akumulasi CO dan SO2) terparah
SELECT TOP 3
    kota,
    ROUND(SUM(co_ug_m3 + so2_ug_m3), 2) AS total_polusi_gas
FROM dbo.v_gabungan
GROUP BY kota
ORDER BY total_polusi_gas DESC;

-- 3. Tentukan kota dengan rata-rata AQI tertinggi selama bulan Januari 2026
SELECT
    kota,
    ROUND (AVG (pm2_5_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_pm2_5,
    ROUND (AVG (pm10_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_pm10,
    ROUND (AVG (no2_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_no2,
    ROUND (AVG (so2_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_so2,
    ROUND (AVG (o3_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_o3,
    ROUND (AVG (co_ug_m3), 2) AS avg_co
FROM dbo.v_gabungan
WHERE waktu_dt >= '2026-01-01' AND waktu_dt < '2026-02-01'
GROUP BY kota
ORDER BY avg_pm2_5 DESC;

import time, requests, pandas as pd

def ambil_cuaca(lat, lon, percobaan=5):
    for i in range(percobaan):
        try:
            r = requests.get("https://archive-api.open-meteo.com/v1/archive", params={
                "latitude": lat, "longitude": lon,
                "start_date": "2026-01-01", "end_date": "2026-09-30",
                "hourly": "temperature_2m,relative_humidity_2m,precipitation,wind_speed_10m",
                "timezone": "Asia/Jakarta"}, timeout=(20, 120))
            r.raise_for_status()
            return pd.DataFrame(r.json()["hourly"])
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"  percobaan {i+1} gagal: {type(e).__name__}, coba lagi...")
            time.sleep(5 * (i + 1))
    raise RuntimeError("Open-Meteo tidak bisa dihubungi")

import time
from delta.tables import DeltaTable

p8            = f"{curated}/pertemuan8"
path_parquet  = f"{p8}/A_parquet_flat"
path_delta    = f"{p8}/B_delta_flat"
path_partisi  = f"{p8}/C_delta_kota_bulan"
path_p5       = f"{curated}/polusi_cuaca"

hasil_ukur, hasil_folder = [], []

def ukur(skenario, tahap, fn, ulang=1):
    for i in range(ulang):
        t0 = time.time()
        out = fn()
        d = round(time.time() - t0, 2)
        label = tahap if ulang == 1 else f"{tahap} (run {i+1})"
        hasil_ukur.append((skenario, label, d))
        print(f"{skenario} | {label}: {d} dtk")
    return out

def info_folder(path):
    n, b = 0, 0
    for f in mssparkutils.fs.ls(path):
        nama = f.name.rstrip("/")
        if nama.startswith("_"):
            continue
        if f.isDir:
            n2, b2 = info_folder(f"{path}/{nama}")
            n, b = n + n2, b + b2
        elif nama.endswith(".parquet"):
            n, b = n + 1, b + f.size
    return n, b

def catat_folder(skenario, path):
    n, b = info_folder(path)
    hasil_folder.append((skenario, n, round(b / 1024 / 1024, 2)))
    print(f"{skenario}: {n} file, {b/1024/1024:.2f} MB")
